pages.useful_because: This page gives a homeowner a hands-on way to check for a hidden leak before calling: the water meter test plus five other clues (warm floor spots, running-water sounds, bill jumps against the same month last year, damp baseboards, a water heater that runs too much) in a tick-box list that counts the clues ticked. It explains the three places hidden leaks usually are (walls, under a slab, the yard water line) and compares the three fixes once a leak is found (spot repair, reroute, full water line replacement) in a table covering what gets opened up, when each fits, and the question to ask about each. It also covers water under a floor that comes from a drain rather than a supply line, and uses Rock'n G's own under-floor and trench photos.
